title: Animal support and sample concentration
legend: Numbers inside points show contributing animals per species. Horizontal position shows the largest animal share of retained objects in each assay. Seven morphology species and four IOD species have one observed animal. Fixed phylogenetic species order.
alt_text: Species points show one to four animals, with object contributions concentrated to varying degrees in the largest contributing animal.

title: Species estimates under equal-animal summaries
legend: Percent change from released to equal-animal summaries. Cell/nucleus summaries are medians of per-animal medians; IOD averages image medians within animal before averaging animals. The genome anchor is recomputed consistently.
alt_text: Three points per species show changes in genome size, cell area, and nucleus area after animal-balanced aggregation.

title: Conditional relationships under both summaries
legend: Released versus animal-balanced PGLS coefficients using identical full24 log10 scaling. Whiskers are 95% t intervals. Full24 and exclusion of aeneus+wrighti are both shown. Specified conditional regressions do not establish causal direction.
alt_text: Coefficient forest compares genome-cell, cell-nucleus, and direct genome-nucleus conditional relationships under two species-summary definitions.

title: Model support after resampling and species removal
legend: 250 hierarchical animal-image-object draws under equal-animal summaries;24 leave-one-species-out fits using released summaries. Boxplots and points show candidate weights; labels count first ranks. Cross-assay resampling is independent. Single-animal species cannot estimate animal-level uncertainty.
alt_text: Weight distributions compare cell-bridge, genome-bridge, nucleus-bridge, and body-only hypotheses under two sensitivity procedures.
